notes.title: The demo is out Now!!
notes.notes:
🎉 Today marks my child's 100th day since birth, and I couldn't be more excited! To celebrate this special milestone, I'm thrilled to announce that the demo is officially out! 🎮✨

A huge thank you to all of our amazing beta testers—you truly mean the world to me. Your support and feedback have been invaluable in bringing this project to life. 🌟

Here's to many more exciting days ahead, and I can't wait for everyone to dive into the demo! 💖🙏

Get it here NOW!!!👇
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065840/One_Room_Dungeon_Demo/]demo[/url]

Hopefully, people will join this game as I did when I made it. 
See you till the next update.

notes.title: New Gameplay Demo Update Version 0.6
notes.notes:
After received feedbacks. I have decided to recreate the whole new gameplay, in order to deliver OP vs OP experienced to players.

Update:
* Upgrade visuals
* Changed gameplay into fast paces.
* Make player free to move + Dash
* Enemies are more aggressive and fast
* Bullet hell
* Added new bosses

Please check it out. And try to win your destiny.

This might take up to 12 hours to upload the game on the store.
